outcome: Efficacy of treatment (difference in ICIQ-SF scores)
cohort: 42 Chilean women with mild-to-severe Stress Urinary Incontinence (SUI) were treated with laser therapy.
finding: Non-ablative Er:YAG laser treatment significantly improved ICIQ-SF scores, with 78.6% reporting improvement and 38.1% complete healing of SUI, and also improved sexual gratification for sexually active women with only mild pain reported as an adverse effect.
